decisions.summary: Extract Subject Distillation runtime ownership from Vault into the separate Digital Life Identity product while preserving completed origin history.
decisions.scope: Vault/DLI responsibility boundary, T-001 through T-033 disposition, referenced GitHub issue disposition, compatibility, and one-way future integration.
decisions.basis: Owner-provided Digital Life Identity Runtime v0.1 SDD and explicit instruction to begin VAM-001 on 2026-08-21 Asia/Taipei.
decisions.reopen_condition: A verified requirement shows that governed identity modeling cannot remain outside Vault without violating the generic Memory API boundary.
